name: blood.jpg
title: File:Blood cells 090304-F-5951M-108.jpg
artist: U.S. Air Force photo / Airman 1st Class Laura Max
usage: The real red blood cell: stained human blood down a microscope, showing the biconcave discs with pale centres and one small purple white blood cell. Paired with the drawn RED_BLOOD_CELL diagram.

name: capillary.jpg
title: File:A red blood cell in a capillary, pancreatic tissue - TEM.jpg
usage: A single red blood cell inside a capillary, bent into a curve because the vessel is narrower than the cell. Carries the book's first red-blood-cell adaptation (p.18: small enough to get through capillaries) and the key word 'capillary'. The original's scale-bar caption strip was cropped off the bottom.

name: neuron.jpg
title: File:Neuron in tissue culture.jpg
usage: The real neurone: a single green-stained nerve cell with its cell body and long branching processes (dendrites and axon). Paired with the drawn NEURONE diagram.

name: trachea.jpg
title: File:Trachea (mammal) histology cross-section.png
usage: The real ciliated cells: the lining of the trachea, with the fringe of cilia along the dark epithelial edge. Paired with the drawn CILIATED_CELL diagram.

name: roothair.jpg
title: File:Lepidium sativum 2018-05-11 1844.jpg
usage: The real root hairs: garden cress germinating in soil, the white fuzz on each young root being the root hairs. Paired with the drawn ROOT_HAIR_CELL diagram.

name: leaf.jpg
title: File:Angiosperm Morphology Mesophyll Arrangement in Syringa Leaf (36176478164).jpg
artist: Berkshire Community College Bioscience Image Library
usage: The real palisade cells: a lilac (Syringa) leaf cross-section with the tall column-shaped palisade layer just under the top epidermis, spongy mesophyll below. Paired with the drawn PALISADE_CELL diagram.
